heroSub: At Candy Hoover's cooker appliance factory in Eskisehir, test data from the production line was automatically collected and matched to each product.
contextTitle: Digital and traceable test data management
contextP1: In this project implemented at Candy Hoover's cooker appliance factory in Eskisehir, test data generated on the production line was automatically collected and associated with each product.
contextP2: The objective was to manage test data in a digital and fully traceable way.
problemTitle: Manual logging, error risk, and limited traceability
problemLede: Electrical and gas leakage test data was manually entered into Excel. This caused time loss, increased data entry errors, and made reliable product-level traceability difficult.

problemList.text: Manually processing test data created operational load and slowed down the workflow.
Manual inputs increased the risk of quality and reliability issues.
Without robust product-result matching, traceability remained limited.

solutionTitle: Automatic test data capture and serial-number matching
solutionLede: By integrating test devices, electrical and gas leakage data was captured automatically and linked to the correct product via serial number reading.

steps.title: Product Arrives at Station
steps.text: When a product reaches the test station, its serial number is read by barcode scanner.

steps.title: Automatic Device Data Capture
steps.text: Results are automatically collected from electrical and gas leakage test devices.

steps.title: Serial Number Matching
steps.text: Captured test data is matched to the read product serial number.

steps.title: Central Recording and Monitoring
steps.text: Data is recorded in OnSuite Trace and becomes available for monitoring and reporting.

techTitle: Test devices, barcode scanners, PLC, and OnSuite Trace

techGrid.title: Electrical and Gas Leakage Test Devices
techGrid.text: Shop-floor equipment producing electrical and gas leakage test results automatically.

techGrid.title: Barcode Scanners
techGrid.text: Read product serial numbers at station entry to trigger correct data matching.

techGrid.title: PLC Integration
techGrid.text: Coordinates station flow and manages data exchange between devices and software.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace
techGrid.text: Central platform for traceability operations and process visibility.

integrationTitle: Integrated flow across test stations, MES, and traceability platform
integrationDesc: The system combines test station outputs with product serial numbers and works integrated with Candy Hoover's Global MES System and OnSuite Trace.

integrationList.text: Device results are matched with scanned serial numbers and saved to the correct product record.
Collected data is synchronized with Candy Hoover's Global MES to support centralized visibility.

resultsTitle: Eliminated manual work and improved test traceability

resultsGrid.title: Automated Data Collection
resultsGrid.text: Manual Excel entry was removed and test data collection became fully automated.

resultsGrid.title: Reduced Errors and Time Loss
resultsGrid.text: Data entry errors and time losses caused by manual operations were significantly reduced.

resultsGrid.title: Product-Level Traceability
resultsGrid.text: Automatic serial-number matching improved traceability and reporting reliability.
